faults.description: no CAN reply from hip motors within 2 s of boot
hip CAN feedback timed out during operation
ESTOP requested by user via GUI button or radio
wheel velocity exceeded 2× soft governor limit
IMU left NOMINAL while RUNNING/JUMPING (silence or heavy loss)
wheel encoder timeout or ODrive error during operation
no CAN reply from wheel motors within 2 s of boot
standup denied (pitch out of recoverable range) or exhausted retries/diverged

commands.description: payload: none — GUI heartbeat; feeds the MANUAL GUI watchdog only
payload: none — triggers a full MCU reset (reruns setup())
PC→ESP32 only (intercepted, never forwarded to Teensy):
payload: uint16_t param_id, float value  (6 bytes after cmd_id)
payload: uint8_t sub_cmd [, args] — high-datarate SD logging
payload: none — reverts all writable params to

parameters.name: imu_enable
parameters.description: BNO086 IMU present (SPI). 0 = skip init/poll and stop gating STARTUP/CALIBRATION/RUNNING on it; also blocks RUNNING since real pitch feedback is required. Persisted; takes effect at boot (needs reboot).

parameters.name: buzzer_volume
parameters.description: Buzzer master volume. 0.0 = silent, 1.0 = max, scales linearly in between. Persisted; takes effect at boot.

parameters.name: led_enable
parameters.description: Status RGB LED present. 0 = skip init/poll. Persisted; takes effect at boot.

parameters.name: hip_l_enable
parameters.description: Left AK45 hip motor present. 0 = skip CAN traffic and stop gating STARTUP/CALIBRATION on it. RUNNING/JUMPING blocked unless all 4 motor-enable flags are set. Persisted; takes effect at boot.

parameters.name: hip_r_enable
parameters.description: Right AK45 hip motor present. 0 = skip CAN traffic and stop gating STARTUP/CALIBRATION on it. RUNNING/JUMPING blocked unless all 4 motor-enable flags are set. Persisted; takes effect at boot.

parameters.name: wheel_l_enable
parameters.description: Left ODrive wheel motor present. 0 = skip CAN traffic and stop gating STARTUP/CALIBRATION on it. RUNNING/JUMPING blocked unless all 4 motor-enable flags are set. Persisted; takes effect at boot.

parameters.name: wheel_r_enable
parameters.description: Right ODrive wheel motor present. 0 = skip CAN traffic and stop gating STARTUP/CALIBRATION on it. RUNNING/JUMPING blocked unless all 4 motor-enable flags are set. Persisted; takes effect at boot.

parameters.name: watchdog_enable
parameters.description: Enable hardware watchdog (WDOG1) — auto-reboots the MCU if the main loop stalls. Default off. Takes effect at boot; once armed cannot be disabled in software until the next reset.

parameters.name: loop_profile_enable
parameters.description: Debug: log a rolling max of loop()-section timings once/sec. Not persisted.

parameters.name: hip_running_kp
parameters.description: MIT position gain used for hip setpoints while RUNNING.

parameters.name: hip_running_kd
parameters.description: MIT damping gain used for hip setpoints while RUNNING.

parameters.name: hip_running_tff
parameters.description: MIT feedforward torque used for hip setpoints while RUNNING.

parameters.name: hip_running_ramp_s
parameters.description: Seconds to ramp kp/tff from 0 to their running value after entering RUNNING, easing in instead of snapping. kd applies at full value throughout. 0 = no ramp.

parameters.name: estop_hip_disable
parameters.description: 1 = exit MIT mode on ESTOP entry and re-enter on reset; 0 = leave MIT running through ESTOP.

parameters.name: calib_seek_speed
parameters.description: Ramp speed toward hardstop while seeking [rad/s].

parameters.name: calib_kp_bottom
parameters.description: Position gain while seeking SEEK_BOTTOM (retract, weight-assisted); also reused by CAL_RETURN_HOME's traverse-back move.

parameters.name: calib_kd
parameters.description: Damping while seeking, both phases.

parameters.name: calib_hold_kp
parameters.description: Position gain while holding at home.

parameters.name: calib_hold_kd
parameters.description: Damping while holding at home.

parameters.name: calib_stall_cur_btm
parameters.description: Current threshold to declare a hardstop while seeking SEEK_BOTTOM (retract) [A].

parameters.name: calib_stall_db
parameters.description: Max position movement per tick to still count as stalled [rad].

parameters.name: calib_stall_ticks
parameters.description: Consecutive stalled ticks before declaring a hardstop.

parameters.name: calib_margin
parameters.description: Safety margin kept from each hardstop [rad].

parameters.name: calib_safety_bound
parameters.description: Max CAL_SEEK_BOTTOM travel before fault [rad] — worst case an unknown start position needs the full joint range to reach the first hardstop. Geometry-derived; READONLY, edit + reflash to change.

parameters.name: calib_l_seek_dir
parameters.description: Sign (+1/-1) toward left hip bottom hardstop. Wiring-direction constant; READONLY, edit + reflash to change.

parameters.name: calib_r_seek_dir
parameters.description: Sign (+1/-1) toward right hip bottom hardstop. Flipped from -1.0 — confirmed backwards on the hardware bench. Wiring-direction constant; READONLY, edit + reflash to change.

parameters.name: calib_done
parameters.description: 1.0 = calibration has completed at least once (persisted across reboots).

parameters.name: calib_bound_top
parameters.description: Max CAL_SEEK_TOP travel before fault [rad], measured from the just-zeroed bottom hardstop. Geometry-derived; READONLY, edit + reflash to change.

parameters.name: calib_kp_top
parameters.description: Position gain while seeking SEEK_TOP (extend, fights robot weight).

parameters.name: calib_stall_cur_top
parameters.description: Current threshold to declare a hardstop while seeking SEEK_TOP (extend) [A]; higher than the retract threshold since fighting gravity raises baseline current.

parameters.name: calib_retract_en
parameters.description: 1 = run SEEK_BOTTOM (retract), the prerequisite phase that establishes the zero reference. 0 skips the whole axis, like a disabled hip motor. READONLY, edit + reflash to change.

parameters.name: calib_extend_en
parameters.description: 1 = run SEEK_TOP (extend) after retract. 0 holds at CAL_HOLD_RETRACT instead — no limits computed, calibration_done() never fires for that axis. READONLY, edit + reflash to change.

parameters.name: calib_rampdown_s
parameters.description: Seconds to ramp kp/kd from hold values down to zero before calibration_done() fires, so exiting CALIBRATION never yanks torque to zero in one tick. 0 = no ramp.

parameters.name: calib_bypass_en
parameters.description: 1 = allow RUNNING mode without a completed hardstop calibration (hip position limits unenforced — bench-test only). Persisted; default 0.

parameters.name: wm_enc_timeout_ms
parameters.description: Wheel encoder feedback watchdog timeout [ms]; increase if CAN is flaky. ODrive PID gains aren't exposed here — tune via the ODrive USB GUI (CAN can't reach those properties on 0.5.x).

parameters.name: lqr_enable
parameters.description: 1 = wheel torque output active; 0 = LQR runs but outputs zero.

parameters.name: sim_pitch_rad
parameters.description: Pitch value injected in place of real IMU pitch when enable_sim_pitch=1.

parameters.name: lqr_torque_limit
parameters.description: |tau_sym| clamp [N·m]; hard max 7.0. READONLY — slewed automatically from the active CH9 speed profile's torque_lim. Edit profile1/2/3_torque_lim instead.

parameters.name: wm_vel_limit
parameters.description: Per-tick soft wheel velocity governor [turns/s]; ESTOP at 2x this.

parameters.name: vel_pi_en
parameters.description: 1 = velocity PI active; 0 = theta_ref fixed at 0.

parameters.name: vel_pi_kp
parameters.description: Velocity PI proportional gain [rad/(m/s)].

parameters.name: vel_pi_ki
parameters.description: Velocity PI integral gain [rad/m].

parameters.name: vel_pi_kff
parameters.description: Velocity PI acceleration feedforward gain [s²·rad/m] (≈ 1/g).

parameters.name: vel_pi_theta_max
parameters.description: |theta_ref| hard clamp [rad].

parameters.name: vel_pi_rate_lim
parameters.description: theta_ref slew rate limit [rad/s].

parameters.name: vel_pi_int_max
parameters.description: Velocity PI integrator anti-windup clamp [rad·s].

parameters.name: v_cmd_ms
parameters.description: Desired forward velocity setpoint [m/s]; GUI/Phase3 testing.

parameters.name: yaw_pi_en
parameters.description: 1 = yaw PI active; 0 = tau_yaw fixed at 0.

parameters.name: yaw_pi_kp
parameters.description: Yaw PI proportional gain [N·m/(rad/s)].

parameters.name: yaw_pi_ki
parameters.description: Yaw PI integral gain [N·m/rad].

parameters.name: yaw_pi_torque_max
parameters.description: |tau_yaw| clamp [N·m].

parameters.name: yaw_pi_int_max
parameters.description: Yaw PI integrator anti-windup [N·m·s].

parameters.name: omega_cmd_rds
parameters.description: Desired yaw rate [rad/s]; positive = CCW from above.

parameters.name: ff1_alpha
parameters.description: Hip reaction cancel feedforward gain [0–1]; start at 0, ramp up.

parameters.name: ff2_alpha
parameters.description: Gravity compensation feedforward gain [0–1]; start at 0, ramp up.

parameters.name: ff1_kt_hip
parameters.description: AK45-10 hip motor output torque constant [N·m/A]; hardware characteristic, not a tuning knob. READONLY, edit + reflash to change.

parameters.name: jump_enable
parameters.description: Master gate for jump sequence: 0 = no-op, 1 = execute.

parameters.name: jump_torque_max
parameters.description: Max hip feedforward torque during EXTEND [N·m]; ramp up from 0.

parameters.name: jump_crouch_time
parameters.description: CROUCH phase duration [s].

parameters.name: jump_ramp_up
parameters.description: EXTEND torque softstart duration [s].

parameters.name: jump_ramp_down
parameters.description: Torque→zero zone near the extended limit [rad].

parameters.name: jump_omega_max
parameters.description: Hip velocity above which feedforward torque → 0 [rad/s].

parameters.name: jump_hs_margin
parameters.description: Hard cutoff margin from the calibrated hardstop [rad].

parameters.name: jump_kp
parameters.description: Position gain for CROUCH/RETRACT phases.

parameters.name: jump_kd
parameters.description: Damping for CROUCH/RETRACT phases.

parameters.name: jump_ext_kd
parameters.description: Small damping during EXTEND (electrical damping only).

parameters.name: jump_ext_timeout
parameters.description: Max time in EXTEND before forced RETRACT [s].

parameters.name: enable_sim_pitch
parameters.description: 1 = use sim_pitch_rad instead of real IMU pitch.

parameters.name: sim_pitch_rate
parameters.description: Pitch rate injected in place of real IMU pitch rate when enable_sim_prate=1 [rad/s].

parameters.name: enable_sim_prate
parameters.description: 1 = use sim_pitch_rate instead of real IMU pitch rate.

parameters.name: pitch_watchdog_en
parameters.description: 1 = ESTOP (FAULT_PITCH_WATCHDOG) if |pitch| > 50° for > 200 ms. Default on and NOT persisted — always starts back on after reboot so a bench-test disable can't silently survive into a real run.

parameters.name: lqr_k_pitch_ret
parameters.description: LQR pitch gain, fully retracted leg. Default -0.3 — conservative bench-tuning starting point, not the earlier sim-derived value.

parameters.name: lqr_k_rate_ret
parameters.description: LQR pitch-rate gain, fully retracted leg. Default -0.1 — conservative bench-tuning starting point, not the earlier sim-derived value.

parameters.name: lqr_k_pitch_ext
parameters.description: LQR pitch gain, fully extended leg. Default -0.3 — conservative bench-tuning starting point, not the earlier sim-derived value.

parameters.name: lqr_k_rate_ext
parameters.description: LQR pitch-rate gain, fully extended leg. Default -0.1 — conservative bench-tuning starting point, not the earlier sim-derived value.

parameters.name: lqr_k_vel
parameters.description: LQR velocity-error gain, invariant across leg height. Default -0.007.

parameters.name: run_wheel_bypass_en
parameters.description: 1 = allow RUNNING mode to arm with wheel_l/r_enable off (bench-test only, e.g. a software-triggered smoke test with hips also disabled, no real torque anywhere). Independent of calib_bypass_en, which only covers the hip check. Not persisted — always boots to 0 (bypass off).

parameters.name: alpha_force_ret_en
parameters.description: 1 = force the hip gain-schedule blend to alpha=0.0 (fully-retracted LQR gains), bypassing the hm_limits valid-calibration check entirely. For hardware tuning with hips zip-tied retracted and disabled, where real calibration can never complete. Not persisted — always boots to 0.

parameters.name: gui_motion_ctrl_en
parameters.description: 1 = v_cmd_ms/omega_cmd_rds are driven by GUI/CLI param_set instead of CH2/CH4; radio arming (CH10) is unaffected. Auto-clears (reverting to radio control) if no GUI command arrives for 300 ms. Not persisted — always boots to 0.

parameters.name: standup_enable
parameters.description: Master gate: 0 = arm goes STANDBY->RUNNING directly (today's behavior). 1 = arm routes through STANDING_UP recovery first. Default 0.

parameters.name: standup_pitch_fwd
parameters.description: Arm-time gate: max forward pitch [rad] considered recoverable. Default 0.6 (~34°).

parameters.name: standup_pitch_bwd
parameters.description: Arm-time gate: max backward pitch [rad] considered recoverable. Default 0.6 (~34°).

parameters.name: standup_crouch_kp
parameters.description: Hip MIT position gain during the CROUCH ramp, held through RECOVER/PAUSE. Mirrors jump_kp.

parameters.name: standup_crouch_kd
parameters.description: Hip MIT damping gain, same phases. Mirrors jump_kd.

parameters.name: standup_crouch_time
parameters.description: CROUCH phase (leg retraction) duration [s]. Default 0.30.

parameters.name: standup_k_pitch
parameters.description: Recovery P gain on pitch [N·m/rad], same positive-sign convention as the LQR/FF2 terms. Starts at 0 — tune up on the bench.

parameters.name: standup_k_rate
parameters.description: Recovery D gain on pitch rate. Starts at 0 — tune up on the bench.

parameters.name: standup_torque_lim
parameters.description: |tau_recover| clamp [N·m], applied before the hard MOTOR_TRQ_MAX clamp. Starts at 0 — tune up on the bench; max = MOTOR_TRQ_MAX (7.0).

parameters.name: standup_vel_limit
parameters.description: Dedicated runaway-backup baseline [turns/s], trips at 2x — independent of wm_vel_limit so tuning one doesn't loosen the other's margin.

parameters.name: standup_cap_pitch
parameters.description: |pitch| below this [rad] (+ rate below standup_cap_rate) for the hold time => captured (handoff to RUNNING).

parameters.name: standup_cap_rate
parameters.description: |pitch_rate| capture threshold [rad/s].

parameters.name: standup_cap_hold
parameters.description: Continuous in-band duration [s] required before handoff.

parameters.name: standup_timeout
parameters.description: Max time [s] in one RECOVER attempt before declaring it failed-to-converge (not diverged).

parameters.name: standup_max_retries
parameters.description: Retry attempts after the first (total attempts = this + 1); int-as-float, mirrors calib_stall_ticks convention.

parameters.name: standup_retry_pause
parameters.description: Wheels-off settle time [s] between retry attempts.

parameters.name: radio_hip_cmd
parameters.description: Hip extension command from CH3 [0=retracted, 1=extended]; firmware-written, stale when the radio link is dead.

parameters.name: radio_vel_max
parameters.description: Max forward speed mapped from full CH2 deflection [m/s]. READONLY — copied from the active CH9 profile's vel_max. Edit profile1/2/3_vel_max instead.

parameters.name: radio_yaw_max
parameters.description: Max yaw rate mapped from full CH4 deflection [rad/s]. READONLY — copied from the active CH9 profile's yaw_max. Edit profile1/2/3_yaw_max instead.

parameters.name: radio_pitch_trim
parameters.description: Pitch equilibrium trim from CH7 [rad]; hook only, not yet applied to LQR.

parameters.name: profile1_vel_max
parameters.description: Speed profile 1 (slow) max forward speed [m/s]; CH9 3-position switch selects the active profile.

parameters.name: profile1_yaw_max
parameters.description: Speed profile 1 (slow) max yaw rate [rad/s].

parameters.name: profile1_torque_lim
parameters.description: Speed profile 1 (slow) LQR torque limit [N·m].

parameters.name: profile2_vel_max
parameters.description: Speed profile 2 (normal) max forward speed [m/s].

parameters.name: profile2_yaw_max
parameters.description: Speed profile 2 (normal) max yaw rate [rad/s].

parameters.name: profile2_torque_lim
parameters.description: Speed profile 2 (normal) LQR torque limit [N·m].

parameters.name: profile3_vel_max
parameters.description: Speed profile 3 (fast) max forward speed [m/s].

parameters.name: profile3_yaw_max
parameters.description: Speed profile 3 (fast) max yaw rate [rad/s].

parameters.name: profile3_torque_lim
parameters.description: Speed profile 3 (fast) LQR torque limit [N·m].

parameters.name: active_profile
parameters.description: Active speed profile index (0/1/2), selected by CH9; firmware-written, READONLY.
